source: Continued requested number practice using prices
summary: Correct hundreds 800/900 after introduction. Cinuenta needed cincuenta, then retained on next use. Mil used correctly; seiscenta corrected to seiscientos, followed by correct focused retry and full 1670 transfer. Correctly distinguished 1890 and 1980 after tens vocabulary supplied.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de novecientos cinuenta y ocho euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de novecientos cincuenta y ocho euros.
observations.outcome: Novecientos and y ocho correct; cinuenta corrected to cincuenta, restoring c after cin.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de ochocientos cincuenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de ochocientos cincuenta euros.
observations.outcome: Ochocientos and corrected cincuenta correct immediately after feedback.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de mil seiscenta cincuenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de mil seiscientos cincuenta euros.
observations.outcome: Mil and cincuenta correct; seiscenta corrected to seiscientos. Contrasted 60 sesenta and 600 seiscientos = seis + cientos.
Correct focused immediate retry after full model; does not alone prove independent recall.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de mil seiscientos setenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de mil seiscientos setenta euros.
observations.outcome: Correct full-sentence transfer after focused seiscientos retry.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de mil ochocientos noventa euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de mil ochocientos noventa euros.
observations.outcome: Correct 1890 after ochenta/noventa vocabulary and 90/900 contrast supplied.

observations.learnerText: El precio es de mil novecientos ochenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de mil novecientos ochenta euros.
observations.outcome: Correct switch to 1980 after 1890, distinguishing hundreds from tens. Immediate transfer; delayed retention untested.

observations.tutorText: 800 ochocientos; 900 novecientos; 1000 mil; 1500 mil quinientos. Use mil directly without un. 80 ochenta; 90 noventa; compare noventa with novecientos. Reinforced 60 sesenta versus 600 seiscientos = seis + cientos.
observations.outcome: Examples and explanations actually supplied in this batch.

nextSteps: Recall seiscientos and cincuenta after a gap, and revisit setecientos spelling from earlier practice.
Recall 1890 versus 1980 without a fresh model.
Continue useful numbers; 100 versus 101–199 have not yet been introduced in this chat.
assessmentNote: Introduced vocabulary, immediate corrected reuse and within-session transfer recorded; no long-term mastery inferred.
